notes:
Lead: Lacuna ChatGlow (chatglow.io) — early-stage B2B SaaS building an in-app chat assistant for sales ops teams. Signed up self-serve, redeem trial credits. Primary ask = streaming low-latency generation inside their single-page app. P95 target: <250ms for short turn-taking (user prompt -> first token), typical ctx 256 tokens. Throughput: initial ~200 concurrent users, expected growth to 2k users in 6mo; estimate 30–50k messages/day at scale. Preference for open models (Llama-like) but willing to use Redwood hosted catalog if latency + cost OK.

Key technical notes: wants web-socket streaming, connection stickiness to reduce cold-starts, fast KV cache for repeated snippets, and deterministic fallbacks to a smaller model when load spikes. Concerned about jitter on streaming and token-level billing. Asked: "Can we get p95 numbers from NA-hosted and an approach to reduce token costs without hurting response quality?" (CTO quote: "latency or nothing — users notice lag immediately").

Security/compliance: SMB, but demands SSO/SAML, audit logs, and KMS integration for client secrets. No VPC or on-prem required today — public cloud only. Data retention: default, but want ability to turn off logs for specific tenants. Team is cost-sensitive and prefers clear per-token egress math in proposal.

Commercial: likely small-monthly commit if hosted API SLA confirmed. ARR estimate based on usage band: $5k–20k. Competition: OpenAI (ease), but they prefer model control + cost predictability. Next immediate: send streaming SDK demo, sample p95 latency report from NA region, and simple cost projection for 50k messages/month. SE to draft technical playbook for their PoC (websocket+streaming + prefix cache).
